nodes.label: Faceless Video Pipeline
nodes.summary: A pipeline turning structured JSON chapter data into narrated, captioned YouTube videos with no stock footage or human faces.

nodes.label: build-chapter.js
nodes.summary: Main CommonJS pipeline orchestrator that runs TTS, audio split, captions, render, concat, and upload.

nodes.label: scene_base.html
nodes.summary: Single visual template using {CONTENT}/{ANIMATIONS}/{DUR}/{BOOK}/{GSAP_SRC} placeholders, source of all scene rendering.

nodes.label: uploadToYouTube()
nodes.summary: Upload function invoked by build-chapter.js using googleapis YouTube Data API v3 + OAuth2.

nodes.label: Node.js 22+
nodes.summary: JavaScript runtime (Node 22+ at C:\node22) running the CommonJS pipeline.

nodes.label: npm
nodes.summary: Package manager for the root pipeline.

nodes.label: pnpm
nodes.summary: Package manager for the ui/ React dashboard.

nodes.label: HyperFrames CLI
nodes.summary: HTML-to-video renderer invoked via npx; renders each scene HTML to MP4.

nodes.label: FFmpeg
nodes.summary: Multimedia tool for audio splitting, scene concatenation, music ducking, and thumbnail extraction.

nodes.label: FFprobe
nodes.summary: FFmpeg companion used for clean JSON duration probing of narration audio.

nodes.label: edge-tts
nodes.summary: Microsoft Edge TTS engine generating narration audio; rate flag must use equals form.

nodes.label: faster-whisper
nodes.summary: Speech-to-text engine producing word-level caption timestamps; CPU base model is slow.

nodes.label: GSAP
nodes.summary: GreenSock animation library driving kinetic captions and scene timeline animations.

nodes.label: TTS Generation
nodes.summary: edgeTts() step producing narration.wav for the full chapter.

nodes.label: Audio Duration Probe
nodes.summary: getAudioDuration() step using ffprobe JSON output to get exact audio length.

nodes.label: Audio Split
nodes.summary: ffmpeg -ss -to step splitting narration into per-scene WAV clips.

nodes.label: Caption Generation
nodes.summary: whisper.generateCaptions() step producing scene captions.srt with manual fallback.

nodes.label: Scene HTML Build
nodes.summary: buildSceneHtml() step merging template, content, and caption JS into scene index.html.

nodes.label: Scene Render
nodes.summary: HyperFrames render step producing per-scene MP4s in parallel batches of 4.

nodes.label: Scene Concatenation
nodes.summary: ffmpeg concat step merging scene MP4s into the final chapter video.

nodes.label: Music Ducking
nodes.summary: Optional sidechaincompress mix step ducking background music under narration.

nodes.label: Thumbnail Extraction
nodes.summary: ffmpeg step extracting the frame at 2s as the video thumbnail.

nodes.label: YouTube Upload
nodes.summary: uploadToYouTube() step uploading the finished MP4 via googleapis OAuth2.

nodes.label: Parallel Render Batches
nodes.summary: Scenes rendered concurrently via Promise.all in batches of 4 to cut wall-clock time.

nodes.label: Frame-Accurate Caption Snapping
nodes.summary: Caption timestamps rounded to the nearest frame (Math.round(t/frameDur)*frameDur) to prevent drift.

nodes.label: Font/Image Pre-flight Guard
nodes.summary: document.fonts.ready + image onload gates the .ready class before HyperFrames captures, avoiding blank frames.

nodes.label: ffprobe for Duration
nodes.summary: Use ffprobe clean JSON for duration probing rather than regex-parsing FFmpeg stderr.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Agent operating guide defining constraints, tech stack anchors, pipeline architecture, and file map.

nodes.label: chapter-{N}.json
nodes.summary: Per-chapter content data: book title, narration script, scenes with html/animations/captions.
